title: Ontario Grade 10 Foundations of Mathematics (MFM2P) — Success Criteria

overalls.title: Similar Triangles
overalls.description: use their knowledge of ratio and proportion to investigate similar triangles and solve problems related to similarity

specifics.description: I can identify and apply properties of similar triangles to solve problems in realistic situations.

overalls.title: Right Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: solve problems involving right triangles, using the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem

specifics.description: I can use the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem to solve problems involving right triangles.
I can apply trigonometry to solve real-world problems involving angles of elevation and depression.

overalls.title: Surface Area and Volume
overalls.description: solve problems involving the surface area and volume of three-dimensional figures, and use the imperial and metric systems of measurement

specifics.description: I can convert measurements between metric and imperial systems and calculate surface area and volume of 3D figures.

overalls.title: Linear Relations and Equations
overalls.description: manipulate numerical and algebraic expressions, and solve first-degree equations

specifics.description: I can simplify algebraic expressions and solve first-degree equations using inverse operations.

overalls.title: Graphing and Writing Equations of Lines
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of characteristics of linear relations and write equations of lines

specifics.description: I can determine slope and y-intercept from tables, graphs, and equations, and graph linear relations.
I can write equations of lines in y = mx + b form given slope, points, or graphical representations.

overalls.title: Linear Systems
overalls.description: solve systems of two linear equations, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can solve systems of two linear equations by graphing and algebraic methods, and interpret the point of intersection.

overalls.title: Characteristics of Quadratic Relations
overalls.description: manipulate algebraic expressions, including expanding and simplifying binomials, and solve quadratic equations

specifics.description: I can expand and simplify binomials and identify key features of quadratic relations.

overalls.title: Graphing Quadratic Relations
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the characteristics of quadratic relations and graph them

specifics.description: I can graph quadratic relations using key features such as vertex, y-intercept, and zeros.
